about: Lookbook tag file: one row per live look. Filter here (tools/lookbook_find.py), then open only the listed sheet. Every example image is our own render from that look's rules. Optional reference, never a rule source.
generated_by: tools/lookbook_sync.py from the breeder export (see modules/lookbook/UPDATING.md)

out_there.1: default: ubiquitous in current commercial work; reads as normal design
out_there.2: familiar revival: widely known and often quoted today, a deliberate period/style choice
out_there.3: specialist: known to designers, rarely in mainstream briefs; reads as a clear reference
out_there.4: deep cut: niche or historically remote; would surprise most clients
out_there.5: far out: no established commercial use; an unfamiliar fusion
out_there.how: established looks hand-scored by Grok Bot (self-judged); keepers = max(breeder novelty score, out_there of nearest looks)

scales.energy: low / medium / high visual energy. Established looks hand-scored; keepers from mood words (self-judged).
scales.read_status: reads = recognisable as the look from our render alone; partial = some layers miss (do not pick as a strong direction); retired = never use
scales.nn_similarity: CLIP ViT-B/32 cosine to the nearest other look (dedup_check.py). FLAG >= 0.90, REVIEW >= 0.85. Same-subject keepers score high on content, not style.
